summary: enCore Energy Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $250 million of common shares. The offering is conducted through Canadian and U.S. sales agents under a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement dated August 13, 2026. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices in ordinary broker transactions. Agents receive compensation up to 2.25% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event involved. The filing describes standard shelf takedown mechanics and risk factors.
